note: Queries of the skewed variant of the engine bench (`engine-bench gen --variant skew`; docs/benchmarks.md, section "Big dimension and skewed data"): Zipf-like keys (100,000 products, customers and stores: a few huge groups, many tiny ones), sales in date order with mostly one unit and no discount (long runs), an order number per few lines (high-cardinality text in the fact), anonymous sales (blank customer). Every query has a full ORDER BY, or a single row.

queries.title: Table by product, 100,000 products (TOPN 501)
queries.dax: EVALUATE TOPN(501, SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Produit[Produit], "CA", [CA], "Qte", [Qte]), [CA], DESC, Produit[Produit], ASC) ORDER BY [CA] DESC, Produit[Produit]

queries.title: By month: sales and distinct orders
queries.dax: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Calendrier[AnneeMois], "CA", [CA], "Commandes", [Nb commandes]) ORDER BY Calendrier[AnneeMois]

queries.title: The biggest and a tiny product (CALCULATE)
queries.dax: EVALUATE ROW("Top", CALCULATE([CA], Produit[Produit] = "P000001"), "Rare", CALCULATE([CA], Produit[Produit] = "P099999"))

queries.title: Slicer on the three biggest products, by region
queries.dax: DEFINE VAR __DS0FilterTable = TREATAS({"P000001", "P000002", "P000003"}, Produit[Produit]) EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Magasin[Region], __DS0FilterTable, "CA", [CA], "Qte", [Qte]) ORDER BY Magasin[Region]

queries.title: Table by order number (TOPN 501 over a text column of the fact)
queries.dax: EVALUATE TOPN(501, SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Ventes[NumCommande], "CA", [CA], "Lignes", COUNTROWS(Ventes)), [CA], DESC, Ventes[NumCommande], ASC) ORDER BY [CA] DESC, Ventes[NumCommande]

queries.title: Store x category in 2024 (skewed stores)
queries.dax: DEFINE VAR __DS0FilterTable = TREATAS({2024}, Calendrier[Annee]) EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Magasin[Magasin], Produit[Categorie], __DS0FilterTable, "CA", [CA]) ORDER BY Magasin[Magasin], Produit[Categorie]

queries.title: Row-by-row SUMX with RELATED over 100,000 prices, one year
queries.dax: EVALUATE ROW("Valeur catalogue", CALCULATE(SUMX(Ventes, Ventes[Quantite] * RELATED(Produit[PrixCatalogue])), Calendrier[Annee] = 2024))

queries.title: Table by customer name (skewed customers, TOPN 501)
queries.dax: EVALUATE TOPN(501, SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Client[Client], "CA", [CA], "Commandes", [Nb commandes]), [CA], DESC, Client[Client], ASC) ORDER BY [CA] DESC, Client[Client]

queries.title: Products with their rank (RANKX over 100,000 products, TOPN 501)
queries.dax: EVALUATE TOPN(501, SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Produit[Produit], "CA", [CA], "Rang", [Rang produit]), [CA], DESC, Produit[Produit], ASC) ORDER BY [CA] DESC, Produit[Produit]

queries.title: By customer segment, anonymous sales included (blank row)
queries.dax: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Client[Segment], "CA", [CA], "Clients", [Nb clients]) ORDER BY Client[Segment]

queries.title: Share of total by year x category
queries.dax: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Calendrier[Annee], Produit[Categorie], "CA", [CA], "Part", [Part CA]) ORDER BY Calendrier[Annee], Produit[Categorie]
